boardRow.name: The Incline
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Twin funicular lines climb the cut: escort the upper haul while defending the lower engine house.

goals: Incline Haul: see an ore cart safely up the upper line.
Defend the lower engine house and stop the Baron's railcar on the lower line.
rules: Two funicular routes cross the water band and climb separate benches.
The lower rail carries the wave-12 railcar; the upper rail carries the escorted ore cart.
The broad banks beside both crossings remain open for sluice work.
Coal seams lie in the lower yard between the haul lines, east of the engine house.
briefing.geographyLine: Twin haul lines climb from one wet lower yard to the ore benches above.

baron.taunt: The Baron's railcar has taken the lower line.
baron.defeatBeat: The upper cart crests while the lower railcar cools in the cut.
